title: Austin's Civic Center & City Affairs
summary:
*   **Civic Center Phase II on Hold**: Key decisions regarding Phase II of the Austin Civic Center Project, including a substantial project management contract for $683,961 and a $720,859 budget reallocation, were postponed to a future meeting.
*   **City Operations Updates**: The City Manager delivered reports covering various municipal functions, specifically the Office on Aging, the West Bull Creek Interceptor project, and employee placement.
*   **No Executive Actions Taken**: The special meeting concluded without the council entering an executive session or making any board and commission appointments.
transcript:
FOUNDER 199
Austin City Council
MINUTES
For SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
Council Chambers, 307 West Second Street, Austin, Texas Memorandum To:
September 29, 1987
-
3:00 Ρ.Μ.
Mayor Pro Tem Trevino called to order the meeting of the Council, noting the absence of
Mayor Cooksey, Councilmembers Carl-Mitchell and Urdy.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
City Manager reports presented were Office on Aging, West Bull Creek Interceptor, Employee
Placement Update.
The report on Update on Interim Development Process was not presented.
ITEMS POSTPONED
Postponed until October 1, 1987 regular meeting is consideration of the following: A
resolution approving a contract with Gilbane Building Company for a not-to-exceed amount
of $683,961.00 for Project Management services for Phase II of Austin Civic Center
Project.
An ordinance amending the 1987-88 Annual Operating Budget and the 1987-88 Capital
Improvement Program (CIP) Budget by transferring $720,859.00 from the Civic Center Reserve
Fund and appropriating it to the CIP Civic Center Project in order to fund the costs of
Phase II. ITEMS NOT DISCUSSED The Council did not go into executive session and did not
make board and commission appointments. ADJOURNMENT Council adjourned its meeting at 4:30
p.m.
